name: Verificador de Comprobantes – Bank Transfer Receipt Upload for WooCommerce
author: csauter

sections.description:
If you sell by bank transfer, SINPE Móvil, Yape, Plin, Nequi or a similar method, you get a screenshot and have to check it against the order by hand. This plugin puts that in one place.

Free, with no account:

  • An upload form on the order received page and in My Account.
  • Receipts stored encrypted on your own site and deleted after 30 days.
  • A box on each order to view the receipt and confirm the payment.

Optional reading service:

Turn it on from WooCommerce > Payment receipts and the service reads each receipt with artificial intelligence, then shows you whether the amount, currency, date and receiving account match the order, and whether the same receipt was already used on another of your orders.

10 receipts a month are free, no card needed. Paid plans for higher volume are offered by the service. Everything in this plugin’s code works without paying: the limit belongs to the external service.

What it does not do:

The plugin never marks an order as paid on its own. It does not move money or connect to your bank. Reading can be wrong: always confirm the payment in your bank before delivering.

The interface is included in English and Spanish. Results from the reading service are currently written in Spanish.

This plugin is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any bank, wallet or Automattic.

External services

This plugin can connect to the Verificador de Comprobantes service to read receipts and compare them with orders. Nothing is sent until a store manager turns on reading and accepts the terms on the settings page.

When and what is sent:

  • When turning on reading: store name, email, the accounts or phone numbers where the store receives payments, and the store currency. The sending server’s IP address is used to limit abuse and is kept only as a hash.
  • Each time a customer uploads a receipt, or a manager clicks “Read now”: the receipt image or PDF, and the order number, amount, currency and date.
  • When opening the settings page: the store key, to show the plan and reads used.
  • When saving the settings: the accounts or phone numbers.

The service does not store the image sent by this plugin. It keeps the result of the reading, the receipt’s fingerprint and its reference number, so it can flag repeated receipts. The image is processed by Anthropic (Claude API) to read it.

  • Service terms
  • Service privacy policy
  • Anthropic terms
  • Anthropic privacy policy

Paid plans are processed by Polar on the service’s website, not inside this plugin. Polar does not receive receipts.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce is required.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Payment receipts and choose the payment methods that should ask for a receipt. Bank transfer is on by default.
  3. Optional: turn on reading to compare each receipt with its order.
sections.faq:
Does it mark orders as paid automatically?

No. You see the result and you confirm. Reading can be wrong, so check your bank before delivering.

What happens if the service is down or the month’s reads run out?

The receipt stays saved on your site and the order shows it was not read, so you can review it by hand.

Which payment methods does it work with?

Any payment method installed in your store. You choose which ones ask for a receipt.

Does it work with SPEI, Bre-B, Nequi, Daviplata, SINPE Móvil, Yape or Plin?

Yes. The customer uploads the screenshot or PDF of the receipt from their bank or wallet: SPEI (Mexico), bank transfer (Chile), Bre-B, Nequi and Daviplata (Colombia), SINPE Móvil (Costa Rica), or Yape and Plin (Peru). You choose which payment methods ask for it.

Where are the receipts stored?

In your site’s uploads folder, encrypted, with random names and never served from a public address. They are deleted after 30 days, or with their order.

Does it work with the block checkout and High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes. The form appears after the order is placed, on the order received page and in My Account.
sections.changelog:
0.1.4

  • New name, so stores looking for a bank transfer receipt upload can find it.
  • After activating, a notice takes you to the settings.
  • The order on-hold email to the customer now has a link to upload the receipt. It also works for guest orders.
  • When the month’s reads run out, the order links to the plans.

0.1.3

  • The plugin’s website link now opens its own page, verificadordecomprobantes.com/woocommerce.
  • The service terms and privacy policy in this readme are now links.

0.1.2

  • Admin styles now load only on the order and settings screens.
  • Removed the bundled Spanish translation, as requested by the Plugins Team. Translations come from translate.wordpress.org.
  • Turning on reading checks the service’s answer before saving the store key.

0.1.1

  • The service moved to its own domain, verificadordecomprobantes.com.

0.1.0

  • First version.

short_description: Customers upload their bank transfer receipt as payment proof on the order. The plugin reads it and shows you whether it matches. You confirm.

screenshots.caption: Your customer uploads the payment receipt on the order received page (and in My Account), with no new account.
On each order, the Payment receipt box shows whether the receipt matches the order. You open it and confirm the payment yourself.
When something does not match, the box says why. Here the same receipt image had already been uploaded on another order.
The orders list gets a Receipt column, so you see at a glance which orders match.
Settings: reading status and monthly reads, the payment methods that ask for a receipt and the accounts where you receive payments.
